hook: What if global commodity prices surged by 23 percent this year?

sections.voiceover: What if global commodity prices surged by 23 percent this year?
The World Bank projects this massive increase throughout 2026. Will logistical disruptions in the Black Sea paralyze grain shipments and push up global food prices?
b_roll: Map showing Iran and oil fields

sections.voiceover: Worse yet, global oil production is dropping by 5.2 percent throughout 2026.
Logistical disruptions in the Black Sea are now impacting global food markets. Food commodity prices are expected to climb by 18 percent during the 2026-2027 period.
b_roll: Cargo ship in the Black Sea

sections.voiceover: Commodity markets face a total increase of 23 percent.
